response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack/backend engineer with deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile systems, but he lacks the core mandatory requirements for this role: no meaningful C++ experience (only a brief stint at National Instruments over a decade ago and a bachelor thesis project), no Windows platform development, no SQL Server/Oracle experience, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure despite one fintech-adjacent role (RIDE Capital) that used Node/TypeScript rather than C++.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across multiple domains
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing) and technical leadership
Fluent English communicator with workshop/teaching experience
concerns: No substantial or recent C++ development experience (mandatory 5-10 years requirement not met)
No Windows platform development experience evident in work history
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain knowledge; SQL exposure appears minimal and generic

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income domain experience
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform experience
